shots.title: Ignoring the call

dialog.text: [lazy] [softly] Pura-pura gak denger aja kali ya?

shots.adegan: Uwais lies on his stomach on the bed with his back to the camera, holding a smartphone in both hands toward the pillow, his curly head turned away from the camera toward the door on the left. His face is never visible.
shots.gerak: Uwais keeps tapping the phone, pauses, lifts his head slightly toward the door, then lowers it again. His face stays turned away from the camera.
shots.akhir: Uwais lies on his stomach with his back to the camera, still holding the phone.
shots.suara: Phone game sounds very softly, a ceiling fan humming.
shots.latar: A teenage bedroom in the afternoon: faint phone game sounds, a ceiling fan humming, birds outside the window, a distant motorbike.

shots.title: Getting up
shots.adegan: Uwais lies on the bed with his back to the camera.
shots.gerak: Uwais puts the phone down on the pillow, sits up, stands, and walks toward the door on the left with his back to the camera.
shots.akhir: Uwais walks out through the door, seen from behind.
shots.suara: Bed creaking, footsteps on the floor, a door opening.
shots.latar: A teenage bedroom in the afternoon: bed springs creaking, footsteps on a wooden floor, a door handle turning, birds outside.

shots.title: Kitchen table
shots.narration: [calm] Ibumu, ibumu, ibumu, lalu ayahmu. HR. Bukhari dan Muslim.
shots.lokasi: a warm family kitchen with a wooden dining table, a stack of clean plates, a pot on the stove, sunlight through the window.
shots.adegan: The family dining table with a neat stack of plates and a pot of rice, warm sunlight through the kitchen window.
shots.gerak: Steam rises gently from the rice pot; the camera slowly glides toward the stack of plates.
shots.suara: A soft simmering pot, birds outside.
shots.latar: A home kitchen in the afternoon: a pot simmering softly, a spoon on a plate, birds outside the window.

shots.title: Helping Ummi
shots.lokasi: a warm family kitchen with a wooden dining table, a stack of clean plates, a pot on the stove, sunlight through the window.
shots.adegan: Ummi in a long black hijab and long black dress walks on the left carrying a bowl of vegetables; Uwais walks on the right beside her carrying a stack of plates. Both walk side by side toward the dining table, fully visible from a front three-quarter angle.
shots.gerak: Ummi and Uwais walk to the table together and set down the bowl and the plates; Ummi gently pats Uwais's shoulder.
shots.akhir: Ummi and Uwais stand side by side at the table.
shots.suara: Plates clinking softly, a simmering pot.
shots.latar: A home kitchen in the afternoon: plates clinking gently, a pot simmering, a tap dripping, birds outside.
